phase1_primary.reuse: AX08 consumes AX07 ZERO by exact identity; never run another baseline ZERO solely for paired packaging.

phase2_component_refinement.release: After phase1 supplies complete baseline histories and measured per-case resources; bind exact configs before any refinement. First priority remains completed baseline5 and their plots.
phase2_component_refinement.full_interval: Each released refinement starts from its explicit identical physical zbar20 IC and completes tozbar4; no interpolated coarse checkpoint is called a refined full-history IC.
phase2_component_refinement.q0_angular_rule: For zero shear, isotropic source, angle-independent opacity and normalized weights, scalar equations are angle independent. Document this algebra and observed parity/normalization checks; this does not transfer to a nonzero-shear case.
phase2_component_refinement.no_sign_transfer: Never assign positive-shear numerical errors to negative-shear or half-amplitude histories. Untested contrast uncertainty is UNKNOWN or RESOLUTION_LIMITED, not a quantified upper bound.

negative_completion_release.condition: A negative/odd signed response is to receive resolved accuracy or quantified bound, or final C11 decision requires its missing component controls

half_amplitude_completion_release.condition: A half-amplitude response or amplitude scaling is to receive resolved accuracy or quantified bound, or final C11 decision requires its missing controls

phase2_component_refinement.conditional_releases: Release only the missing relevant component/case rows after actual results. Record each release and its cumulative allocation; this is neither blanket simultaneous execution nor permission to mark untested criteria PASS.
phase2_component_refinement.mixed_error: If component refinements reveal comparable interacting errors, authority binds one joint sequence before its execution. No automatic full Cartesian parameter sweep.
phase2_component_refinement.stopping: After baseline plus two levels, evaluate actual differences. If not asymptotic or above target, report exact resolution limit; a further finite sequence needs a declared scientific reason and new allocation. Do not keep refining merely to force a nonzero detection.

comparison_and_acceptance.primary_comparison_coordinate: ZBAR at common ln(a) samples froma=1/21 toa=1/5; candidate and reference proper clocks both retained
comparison_and_acceptance.common_samples: 1001 equally spaced ln(a) values, plus actual milestone brackets; interpolate only between time-ordered accepted neighbors. Never sort or match by nonmonotonic Tgas.
comparison_and_acceptance.secondary_comparison: Optional PROPER_TIME uses common elapsed-time overlap and reports distinct candidate/reference zbar; never label both clocks and redshifts matched simultaneously.
comparison_and_acceptance.norms: Report supremum absolute difference on represented common grid, endpoint differences and milestone differences; identify interpolation error separately from evolution refinement.
comparison_and_acceptance.empirical_error: Retain all successive differences D01,D12. Only use a Richardson estimate if observed refinement ratios and monotonicity support an order for that observable; otherwise use the observed variation envelope and state lack of continuum guarantee. A three-level comparison is required, not just a smaller target in config.
comparison_and_acceptance.paired_error: Compute Delta_level=Oq_level-O0_level from matched physical-input cases at each available level, then differences of Delta across levels. For q0 angular invariance use its validated unchanged scalar solution; no analogous sign-symmetry shortcut.
comparison_and_acceptance.resolved_response: Supported paired numerical error <=0.1*abs(Delta) above the locked floor. Fraction floor1e-7, Tfloor.01K, Yfloors follow fixed normalization. Model/source/IC/feedback errors remain separate.
comparison_and_acceptance.null_or_bound: A quantified empirical upper envelope requires actual relevant refinement and an explicit estimator; untested or nonconvergent response is only unresolved with unknown numerical uncertainty. No rigorous bound/posterior is invented.
comparison_and_acceptance.even_odd: Even=[O(+q)+O(-q)]/2-O0; odd=[O(+q)-O(-q)]/2. Both signed paths must have applicable numerical evidence for resolved claims; cubic/odd contributions are allowed.
comparison_and_acceptance.milestones: Use actual first upward crossing of local xHII=.1,.5,.9, bracketed linear interpolation; record all additional crossings if present. No crossing yields null plus NOT_REACHED and covered interval. zbar and proper-time shifts are separate columns; xHII is not QV.
comparison_and_acceptance.goal_criteria: Final independent AX15 still decides the original GOAL C01-C16; UNKNOWN flags cannot be used as automatic substitutes for required numerical evidence. Completed abundance histories at an explicitly accepted conditional precision scope are legitimate, but no premature C11 PASS.

phase3_source_ic_robustness.release: After baseline q0 full history and paired family available; may overlap independent AX11 jobs inside concurrency limit.
phase3_source_ic_robustness.comparison: Full-history variant minus matching baseline ZERO, same element/baryon/electron normalization and ZBAR convention. These are named model sensitivities, not posterior intervals.
phase3_source_ic_robustness.claim_limit: These two cases quantify baseline-source/IC sensitivity only. They do not establish robustness of signed shear response. That stronger claim requires separately bound q+ and q- counterpart variants before execution.
phase3_source_ic_robustness.spectral_model_scope: Blackbody versus realistic stellar-population shape remains a disclosed model limitation; no unsupported shape accuracy claim. The frozen minimum source variation is normalization.
